title: Game Night: Free-for-All: card flavor text

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A member of the Capashen line who vows to protect the less fortunate and fight on against despair.

entities.name: Capashen
entities.description: A family or lineage whose members are held to a code of protection and courage.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: The home of elvish kingdoms united in their distrust of outsiders. Its elves remember past disasters such as the Ice Age and the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Burning Ones
entities.description: Draconic beings worshiped by zealots, who praise their mighty fangs.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A figure whose ideals the church's defenders still fight for.

entities.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
entities.description: A defender who fights for Avacyn's ideals and for the church's people rather than the church itself.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of fate and admires dragons as a perfect marriage of power and will.

entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: A leader who prefers loyalty earned by respect rather than magic, but does what she must.

entities.name: Luxa
entities.description: A river from which river drakes are taught to pull the largest prey.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A sky summoner who conquered the depths of Shandalar before his ambitions drove him skyward.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A world whose depths Talrand conquered.

entities.name: Doriel
entities.description: A mentor of Mistral Isle who warns of an illusion that craves violence.

entities.name: Mistral Isle
entities.description: The place where Doriel serves as mentor.

entities.name: Mklthd
entities.description: A jeering homunculus who always hated crowds, and was hated by them.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: An initiate of the Rhet crop who does things in her own time.

entities.name: Rhet crop
entities.description: A group of initiates to which Etha belongs.

entities.name: Malacan
entities.description: An exile from Vantress who speaks on virtue.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: The place from which Malacan was exiled.

entities.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
entities.description: The spymaster of Trest, who quips that soaring is wasted on the winged.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: The place whose spymaster is Edric.

entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: A place known for its terror-pigs, sold as bushmeat by poachers.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A dark figure who scorns angels as pests that die like any other.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler of a city from which dissenters are banished to a single fate.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A place of tombs and temples whose opening unleashed the Immortal Sun and other horrors.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: A faction whose explorers ransacked Orazca hunting for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A sought-after relic hidden in Orazca.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A world where death and decay abound and corpses are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A member of the Order of Saint Traft who found no solace in the church.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order to which Grete belongs.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: A curse that leaves only hatred.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who jokes about not breaking up a family.

entities.name: Zul Ashur
entities.description: A lich lord whose skeletons always show up, even with the wrong bones.

entities.name: Shaile
entities.description: The dean of Silverquill, who laments her brightest students' worst decisions.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: A college whose dean is Shaile.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god whose favorites are said to stand highest in eternity.

entities.name: Senifet
entities.description: A vizier of Bontu who preaches that not all are equal in life or death.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Conquerors who raise cursed scorn poles in conquered villages to sap survivors' strength and will.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A figure who declares peace a privilege unearned.

entities.name: Hurdek
entities.description: A mammoth trainer from Mazar who warns how fast dragons grow.

entities.name: Mazar
entities.description: The home of the mammoth trainer Hurdek.

entities.name: Marsden
entities.description: A party leader who died to a dragon, his last words urging his party to spread out.

entities.name: Dafynne the Radiant
entities.description: A member of Marsden's party who died to a dragon.

entities.name: Theria the Sly
entities.description: A thief who died trying to take from a dragon.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A speaker who grudgingly admits kavu have good aim.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A sea that hisses and bubbles when tapped by a Vulshok shaman.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A people whose shaman draws mana from the Quicksilver Sea.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A warrior who vows vengeance for all he has lost and all who have fallen.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A street known for festival crowds.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: A hunter in the Saga of the Wisdom Seeker who killed a great eagle from a snowy peak.

entities.name: Saga of the Wisdom Seeker
entities.description: An in-world saga telling of the hunter Fynn.

entities.name: Knorjolvin
entities.description: A Tuskeri raider who believes no elf can match a Tuskeri in combat.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A raider people who scorn elves in combat.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane of spires that elves navigate and protect like tall trees.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: A figure who orders a city smashed to pieces.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: A past disaster remembered by Llanowar.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A past disaster remembered by Llanowar.

entities.name: Rift Era
entities.description: A past disaster remembered by Llanowar.

entities.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
entities.description: A ghost chieftain who calls savagery the birthright of every creature.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal world whose creator still lives and commands world-shaking power.

entities.name: Wyllon
entities.description: A merchant of Drannith calling for a medic and stonemasons.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The home of the merchant Wyllon.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: A survivalist of Oran-Rief who extols the machete on expeditions.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: The place associated with survivalist Yon Basrel.

events.summary: In the past, Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, then turned his ambitions skyward with like-minded servants.
events.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

events.summary: Explorers of the Legion of Dusk reach Orazca and ransack its tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: The opening of Orazca unleashes horrors beyond the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Party leader Marsden dies to a dragon, his last words urging his party to spread out.
events.quote: "Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!" —Marsden, party leader, last words

events.summary: Theria the Sly dies trying to steal from a dragon.
events.quote: "Surely it won't notice if I take—" —Theria the Sly, last words

events.summary: Dafynne the Radiant dies to a dragon, telling Marsden it is just playing with them.
events.quote: "It's just playing with us, Marsden." —Dafynne the Radiant, last words

events.summary: In the Saga of the Wisdom Seeker, the hunter Fynn waits hidden in snow atop the highest peak and shoots down a great eagle.
events.quote: When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true.

events.summary: Domri Rade orders a city smashed to pieces.

relations.quote: As a Capashen, I can do no less.
